_doc: v3 settings for the trooptransport (LANCE-19): rigid vehicle, moving parts split out by tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py from trooptransport_prep.json (work dir trooptransport_tracks), fit from tools/art/v3/trooptransport_veh.json via v3_rigid.py.
name: trooptransport

source.title: Packrat, APCs and Heavy APCs for use with Battletech
source.author: Pfelpensson
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19 batch 6, 2026-10-31), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in trooptransport_veh.json). Parts split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (trooptransport_prep.json). Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 1.5 degrees, collapse only above 80k faces a part (no Blender collapse on shell soup). Own-geometry wheels (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) where there are wheels; they are part of the derivative. TRACKED: the kit (Pfelpensson's Heavy Track APC, CC BY 4.0) is a solid hull on a flat track skirt, so the belts `track_l`/`track_r` are the lower side slab (faces within 130 mm of the closed belt path; strip 2 x 220 mm) and the six wheels a side are own geometry on its outer face. No turret (the original has none).
